name: Selestija
source:
Lost friend of Neon. A brilliant pianist obsessed with finding the perfect sound and harmony. In the past, she was a gentle and vulnerable girl who found solace in her friendship with Neon.
After the “incident” in the park and her separation from Neon, her psyche began to crumble.
